transcriber_notes: Rows: 10 (1924-1933) in each part, as printed. '—' as printed; '%' printed only on the first Rate of Dividend figure.

The 'Total' column equals Loans + Advances Bills Discounted (checked row by row): 8 of 10 rows reconcile as transcribed; 1924 (Loans+Advances = 716,713 vs printed 716,714, diff 1) and 1925 (670,861 vs printed 670,859, diff −2) do NOT reconcile — left as printed.
3-vs-8 (BRIEF exception): Advances 1927 first digit looks like 8 at 350% but only 318,399 reconciles with the printed Total 540,732 (818,399 would not); 318,399 chosen.
3-vs-8: Advances 1929 second digit filled in; only 133,538 reconciles with Total 282,215 (with Loans 148,677, whose 8 shows two counters); 133,538 chosen.
3-vs-8: Total 1930 third digit filled in (looks like 8); only 273,243 reconciles with 144,668 + 128,575; 273,243 chosen.
3-vs-8: Loans 1931 second digit and Advances 1931 second digit filled in; of the combinations only 131,390 + 130,252 = 261,642 reconciles with the printed Total; chosen.

Other 3/8 digits read from shape at 300-600% (flat top = 3): Paid-up 39,375 (1925-26) and 13,125 (1927-33), Reserve 13,780 and 2,354, Dividend 3,678, 395, Rate 3.0, Earnings/Expenses 1930 39,934 / 39,075 (Earnings−Expenses = 859 reconciles with Net Profit).
Earnings 1929 '47,473': last digit read as 3 from its flat top (no total to check; the printed '8' of 47,948 beside it is rounded).
Net Profit checks (Earnings − Expenses): 1924, 1926, 1930-1933 reconcile; 1925: 110,639 − 109,982 = 657 vs printed 1,136 — does NOT reconcile (left as printed). Loss years 1927-1929 print '—'.

Does NOT reconcile: 1924 (53,753 − 50,458 = 3,295 vs 3,294), 1925 (75,768 − 75,058 = 710 vs 706), 1929 (26,186 − 24,821 = 1,365 vs 1,865; Net Profit's 8 is clear; the 8 of Expenses 24,821 looks rounded but partly filled — 24,321 would reconcile; left as read).
Reserve Fund 1931 read 3,701 (flat top); 873 and 821 read with rounded-top 8s; Authorized Capital 1924 80,000 read as 8 (two counters).
